acts.title: Pehla commit
acts.sub: Repo ko bilkul careful insaan ki tarah banayen — ek saaf chore commit.

acts.title: Teen changes, teen commits
acts.sub: Gadbad waali working session ko chhote, reviewable, atomic commits me baant do.

acts.title: Shaanti se ship karo
acts.sub: Experiment branch par rakho, phir bina drama ke land karo — chahe conflict merge par ambush karke aaye.

steps.title: Ek khaali directory — poori ummeedein
steps.body: Aap scratch se ek chhoti website banane ja rahe hain. Pehla asli git kaam hai repo banana — git tab tak kuch kaam ka nahi hai jab tak repo nahi hai.

visual.caption: git init makes the .git directory — objects, refs and the index live inside it.

steps.title: Tay karo kya repo me NAHI aayega
steps.body: Pehle commit se pehle .gitignore banao. Node_modules, build output, aur woh bhatka hua debug.log kabhi tracked nahi hone chahiye. Bahar rakhna bhi discipline ka hissa hai.

visual.caption: Only the ignore rule is staged so far — still nothing committed.

steps.title: Scaffold stage karo, phir ruk jao
steps.body: Ab project shell banane waale teen files stage karo: package.json, lockfile aur README. Craft dhyan se dekho: aap sirf wahi stage kar rahe ho jo IS commit ka hissa hai — 'jo bhi exist karta hai' nahi.

steps.title: Pehla commit
steps.body: Shell ko ek logical unit ki tarah commit karo. Prefix chore matlab housekeeping — abhi user ko dikhe wala koi behavior nahi. Aur subject chhota hai: 26 characters, 50 ke bahut neeche.

steps.title: 50 / 72 rule
steps.body: Human-readable commit aapke future self ko diya hua tohfa hai. Subject 50 characters se chhota rakho — listings me padhne layak. Detail lines 72 par wrap karo. Agar message ko paragraph chahiye, toh uski apni commit banti hai.
steps.cmd: git commit -m "fix: reset focus ring" -m "Pressing space no longer keeps the focus ring stuck after the button closes."

steps.title: Jaal: chhe files, ek commit
steps.body: Asli kaam wala session tree ko gandha chhod deta hai. Yahan: ek bug fix, ek chhoti feature, kuch styling, aur ek stray debug.log — sab ek saath. Kaamchor commit — git add -A; git commit -m "update" — sab kuch ek blob ke neeche daba deta hai.

visual.caption: git status shows 6 changes at once — this is the exactly the situation a careful human splits apart.

steps.title: Logical change ke hisaab se group karo
steps.body: Files ko waise sort karo jaise reviewer sochta hai: bug fix akela, feature ki do files saath, styling akeli — aur debug.log ignore, kabhi committed nahi. Teen logical changes, teen commits. Jaldi ki koi zaroorat nahi.

steps.title: Fix commit karo — chhota aur atomic
steps.body: Ek fix, ek commit, prefix jo kahe fix, subject jo kahe WHAT na ki HOW. Reviewer is line ko padhke turant decide kar sakta hai ki safe hai. Atomic commit ka poora matlab yahi hai.
steps.cmd: git commit -m "fix: reset focus ring on space bar"

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Feature agli hai waari
steps.body: Feature do files me phaili hai, toh dono ko saath stage karo: nav.tsx aur nav.css EK change hain — sidebar apne styles ke bina adhoora hai. Phir feat prefix ke saath commit karo.
steps.cmd: git add src/nav.tsx src/nav.css && git commit -m "feat: add sticky mobile sidebar"

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Style apna chore hai
steps.body: Sirf visual tweaks ko style prefix milta hai — woh kisi ka behavior nahi badalte, aur prefix sabko ek nazar me bata deta hai. Ab teen commits: chore, fix, feat — har ek seconds me review ho jata hai.
steps.cmd: git add src/theme.css && git commit -m "style: align page title spacing"

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Ise changelog ki tarah padho
steps.body: git log --oneline --graph history ko story bana deta hai: chore → fix → feat → style. Har commit itna chhota hai ki soch aaye, aur har prefix ek filter hai. Usse compare karo ek giant 'update stuff' blob se — koi muqaabla nahi.

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

spec.caption: A linear history that reads like a changelog — the reward for atomic commits.

steps.title: Branch par experiment karo
steps.body: Agli feature risky hai, isliye apni branch par rahegi. git switch -c dono kaam karta hai — banata bhi aur jump karta bhi feat/avatar par. main saaf aur shippable rehta hai jab tak aap experiment karte ho.

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Kaam branch par hota hai
steps.body: Commit feat/avatar par utarta hai, aur main bilkul nahi hilta. Risky kaam trunk ko nahi, branch ko pitata hai. Wahi atomic discipline: ek feature, ek commit.

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Wapas safe line par aao
steps.body: git switch main HEAD ko wapas main line par le jaata hai. Jo kuch banaya woh branch par safe hai — lekin working tree ab shippable trunk dikhata hai. Graph fork hone lagta hai.

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

steps.title: Merge ghar aata hai, aur takra jaata hai
steps.body: feat/avatar ne avatar header ko dobara likha — aur main ke sidebar refactor ne bhi usi file ko chhua. Same hunk, do sach: Git stitch nahi kar paata, isliye dono ko <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> markers ke saath print karta hai aur ROOK deta hai. Abhi kisi ka kuch nahi gaya. Panic button ab bhi kaam karta hai: git merge --abort.

visual.caption: The merge pauses, politely, and hands you the decision

steps.title: Sach chuno, Git ko batao, aur continue karo
steps.body: Aapko feature wala avatar logic CHAHIYE aur main ka naya sidebar styling BHI — toh dono hunks rakho, markers hatayo, save karo. git add file ko resolved mark karta hai, aur git merge --continue ek saaf two-parent merge commit likhta hai. Din phir bhi ship hota hai, aur kisi ne panic nahi kiya.

visual.caption: Markers gone, merge continued, calendar unharmed

steps.title: Poore din ki ek saaf story
steps.body: git log --oneline --graph din ka kaam waise dikhata hai jaise insaan ne kiya: chore scaffold, teen atomic changes, ek forked experiment, ek explicit merge. Chhote commits. Saaf prefixes. Koi 50-file blob nahi. Professionals yahi karte hain.

nodes.msg: fix: reset focus ring on space bar

spec.caption: Six commits, each one logical, one merge, zero panic — a realistic, human day of git.
